newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-ROCKIES PLACE OF ELLIS BURKS ON DISABLED LIST.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-ROCKIES PLACE OF ELLIS BURKS ON DISABLED LIST.

text.p: Colorado Rockies outfielder Ellis Burks, who enjoyed the best season of his career in 1996, Saturday was was placed on the 15-day disabled list with a groin injury.
Burks, who has been hampered by a groin strain over the past month, aggravated the injury Thursday when he beat out an infield hit. He was used only as a pinch hitter Friday.
The 32-year-old Burks is batting .253 in 70 games with 17 homers, 49 RBI and 55 runs scored.

Last season Burks hit .344 -- second in the National League behind Tony Gwynn -- with 40 homers and 128 RBI. He led the league in runs (142), total bases (392), extra-base hits (93) and slugging percentage (.639).
To replace Burks on the roster, the Rockies recalled outfielder Angel Echevarria from Triple-A Colorado Springs, where he was hitting .309 with 11 homers and 67 RBI in 63 games.
